goal.text: Make a family plan for earthquakes.

intro.text: Your family is making an earthquake plan. Join in!

hint.text: Where will your family meet after it shakes?

lesson.text: Plan with your family. Agree on a meeting place and know a family number.

choices.label: Each of us finds our own way
choices.heading: Not ready yet
choices.feedback: Agree on one place to meet. Then you can find each other.

choices.label: Agree on a meeting place
choices.feedback: Good plan. Also remember one family phone number.

choices.label: Plan to meet back at home
choices.feedback: Your house may be damaged. Meet at an open place.

choices.label: Keep numbers only in the phone
choices.heading: Not ready yet
choices.feedback: Phones can be lost. Remember or write down a family number.
